sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Costco shows a solid operating margin as reflected by [[COST.ratio.operating_margin]], indicating disciplined cost management. Its debt-to-equity ratio [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]] points to a conservative financing profile. Free cash flow [[COST.ratio.free_cash_flow]] demonstrates ample cash generation after capital spending, supporting shareholder returns. The price‑earnings multiple [[COST.ratio.price_earnings]] suggests the market assigns a premium relative to earnings, consistent with the company’s strong brand and membership model.

insight.text: The firm’s return on average equity remains robust, underscoring efficient capital use.
